_comment: Curated named passages for /passages and /passage/:slug. One entry = a title + one or more verse ranges (refs use the same grammar as src/lib/models/refs.js: 'Book c:v–v, v–v; Book c:v–v'). Names follow the Novel English Bible's own forms (the headings table is the reference). Bible is the source of truth: a passage is only a window onto the reader's text, never a second copy of it.

passages.title: The Prayer of Azarias
passages.subtitle: Prayer of Azariah
passages.blurb: Standing in the midst of the fire, Azarias confesses the sins of his people and pleads the covenant with Abaraham, Yatzachaq and Yaiqab.

passages.title: The Song of the Three
passages.subtitle: Benedicite
passages.blurb: Chananayah, Mashaal and Izarayah call every work of Yahawah — heavens, waters, frost, beasts and men — to bless him from inside the furnace.

passages.title: The Prayer of Mardocheus
passages.subtitle: Prayer of Mordecai
passages.blurb: Mardocheus, having refused to bow to Aman, calls on the Malak (King) Shaday not to let the mouths of those who praise him be shut.

passages.title: The Prayer of Asathar
passages.subtitle: Prayer of Esther
passages.blurb: Before going in to the king unbidden, Asathar puts off her glory, covers her head with ashes and prays for her people.

passages.title: The Proclamation of Mardocheus
passages.subtitle: The king's second letter, written by Mordecai in the king's name
passages.blurb: The decree that undoes Aman's plot: the Yahawadayam (Jews) are declared to live by just laws and be children of the most high God, and the thirteenth of Adar becomes a day of gladness. Written by Mardocheus with the king's ring — see Esther 8:9–10.

passages.title: The Decree of Kawarash
passages.subtitle: Decree of Cyrus
passages.blurb: In his first year Kawarash king of Paras proclaims that the house of Yahawah be built again at Yarawashalam, and that his exiles go up.

passages.title: The Prayer of Manashah
passages.subtitle: Prayer of Manasseh
passages.blurb: The penitential prayer of the king who filled Yarawashalam with idols: bowed down with iron bands, he asks the God of the righteous for the repentance he has promised sinners.

passages.title: The Song of Chanah
passages.subtitle: Hannah's prayer
passages.blurb: Having received Shamawaal, Chanah exalts the God who raises the poor from the dust — the song Marayam's own would later echo.

passages.title: Shalamah's Dedication Prayer
passages.subtitle: Solomon's prayer at the dedication of the temple
passages.blurb: Before the altar, hands spread toward heaven, Shalamah asks that Yahawah's eyes be open toward the house night and day, and hear every prayer made toward this place.

passages.title: The Prayer of Yaibatz
passages.subtitle: Prayer of Jabez
passages.blurb: Two verses in the genealogies of Yahawadah: a man more honourable than his brothers asks for blessing, a larger border, and a hand kept from evil.

passages.title: The Writing of Chazaqayah
passages.subtitle: Hezekiah's prayer after his recovery
passages.blurb: Recovered from the sickness that should have taken him, Chazaqayah writes of the gates of death and the living who praise.

passages.title: Yawanah's Prayer from the Fish
passages.subtitle: Jonah's prayer
passages.blurb: Out of the belly of the fish, out of the belly of Shaawal, a prayer that ends in a vow: salvation is of Yahawah.

passages.title: Dan's Prayer of Confession
passages.subtitle: Daniel's prayer
passages.blurb: With fasting, sackcloth and ashes, Dan confesses for his people and asks the God who brought them out of Matzarayam to let his face shine on the desolate sanctuary.

passages.title: The Prayer of Chabaqawaq
passages.subtitle: Habakkuk's prayer
passages.blurb: A prayer set to music: God comes from Thayaman, the mountains scatter, and the prophet resolves to rejoice in Yahawah though the fig tree does not blossom.

passages.title: The Lord's Prayer
passages.blurb: The prayer Yashawai gave his disciples in the Sermon on the Mountain.

passages.title: Yashawai's Prayer for His Disciples
passages.subtitle: The high-priestly prayer
passages.blurb: On the night he was betrayed, Yashawai prays for himself, for those given him, and for all who will believe through their word — that they may be one.

passages.title: The Song of Mashah and Marayam
passages.subtitle: The Song of the Sea
passages.blurb: On the far shore of the sea: Yahawah is a man of war, horse and rider thrown into the sea, and Marayam answers with timbrel and dance.

passages.title: The Song of Mashah
passages.subtitle: Deuteronomy 32
passages.blurb: Mashah's last song, taught to all Yashar-Al as a witness: the Rock who begot them, the jealousy of a people gone after no-gods, and the vengeance and atonement of Yahawah for his land.

passages.title: The Song of Dabawarah and Baraq
passages.subtitle: Song of Deborah
passages.blurb: The tribes that came and the tribes that stayed, the stars fighting from heaven, the Qayashawan sweeping Sisera's host away, and Yail's hand on the tent-peg.

passages.title: Dawad's Lament for Shaawal and Yahawanathan
passages.subtitle: The Song of the Bow
passages.blurb: How are the mighty fallen — Dawad's lament over the king who hunted him and the friend he loved.

passages.title: The Song of the Vineyard
passages.blurb: A vineyard on a fruitful hill, fenced and planted with the choicest vine, that brought forth wild grapes: the house of Yashar-Al.

passages.title: The Song of Marayam
passages.subtitle: Magnificat
passages.blurb: In the house of Alayashabai, Marayam magnifies Yahawah who has regarded the low estate of his handmaid and remembered his mercy to Abaraham.

passages.title: The Song of Zakarayah
passages.subtitle: Benedictus
passages.blurb: His tongue loosed at the naming of Yawachanan, Zakarayah blesses the God who has raised up a horn of salvation in the house of Dawad.

passages.title: Yaiqab's Blessing on His Twelve Sons
passages.subtitle: Jacob blesses the tribes
passages.blurb: Dying in Matzarayam, Yaiqab gathers his sons and tells each what will befall him in the last days — the sceptre to Yahawadah, the fruitful bough to Yawasap.

passages.title: The Blessing of Yahawadah
passages.subtitle: Jacob's blessing on Judah
passages.blurb: A lion's whelp, the sceptre that shall not depart until he comes to whom it belongs, the foal bound to the vine.

passages.title: The Blessing of Mashah on the Tribes
passages.subtitle: Moses blesses the tribes
passages.blurb: Before his death Mashah blesses Yashar-Al tribe by tribe: Yahawah came from Sayanay and rose up from Shaiyar, and the eternal God is a refuge.

passages.title: The Priestly Blessing
passages.subtitle: The blessing of Aharawan
passages.blurb: The words Aharawan and his sons are to put the Name upon the children of Yashar-Al with: Yahawah bless you and keep you.

passages.title: The Beatitudes
passages.blurb: Yashawai goes up the mountain, sits, and opens his mouth: blessed are the poor in spirit, the meek, the merciful, the peacemakers.

passages.title: The Ten Commandments
passages.subtitle: The ten words spoken at Sinai
passages.blurb: Yahawah speaks all these words from the mountain: I am Yahawah your God who brought you out of Matzarayam.

passages.title: Hear, O Yashar-Al
passages.subtitle: The Shema — the great commandment
passages.blurb: Yahawah our God, Yahawah is one — and you shall love him with all your heart, and teach these words to your children, and write them on your doorposts.

passages.title: The Promise of a New Covenant
passages.blurb: Days are coming when Yahawah will make a new covenant with the house of Yashar-Al and the house of Yahawadah, and write his law on their hearts.

passages.title: The Valley of Dry Bones
passages.blurb: Set down in a valley full of very dry bones, Yachazaqaal prophesies and hears a noise, a shaking, bone to bone — and the whole house of Yashar-Al stands up, a very great army.

passages.title: The Suffering Servant
passages.blurb: Despised and rejected, wounded for our transgressions, he bears the sin of many and is numbered with the great.

passages.title: The River Flowing from the Temple
passages.blurb: Waters issue from under the threshold of the house, ankle-deep, then knee-deep, then a river that cannot be passed — and everything lives where the river comes.

passages.title: The Holy Portion
passages.subtitle: The oblation for the priests, the Levites, the city and the prince
passages.blurb: The square of 25,000 by 25,000 in the midst of the land: the sanctuary in the middle, the priests' and Levites' portions, the city with its fields, and the prince on either side.

passages.title: The Word Made Flesh
passages.subtitle: The prologue of John
passages.blurb: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God — and the Word became flesh and tabernacled among us.

passages.title: Chanawak's Opening Blessing
passages.subtitle: 1 Enoch 1 — the blessing on the elect and righteous
passages.blurb: The words of the blessing of Chanawak for the elect and righteous who will be living in the day of tribulation: the Holy Great One comes forth from his dwelling with ten thousands of his holy ones.
